text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I drop by the cafeteria to find Manhattan Cafe and Yukino Bijin hanging out together.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, Cafe's trainer! Well, hey there.
choice_data_list: Hello. What are you two doing?
Hello. What are you two doing?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm about to put a drink together for Yukino…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yukino was in her room reading a magazine special on cafes… and she really liked the look of one of the featured beverages…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I couldn't stop wond'rin about the taste, and then Cafe went and asked if I wanted to try one!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: None of the recipes seemed beyond my abilities, so…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's amaz'n how you can whip up all these fancy drinks! You're a real city girl!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …My drinks won't taste quite as nice as the real thing, but I figured you'd still enjoy the atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So… what would you like to drink, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, about that… Every one of 'em looks so snazzy I can't decide which cup of jitt'r juice I fancy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: This one… Nope, that one! Shucks, there's so many…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Cafe's trainer, which one would you pick?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I got no idea which one to plump for, see… And I'd really appreciate your input!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Boy, that sounds awful adult-like… but it also sounds like just the kinda joe I'd like to try!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'll keep the general concept, but make something Yukino can manage…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Here you are. A hot butter au lait.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wow… It smells sweet'r than a honeycomb! You're tell'n me this is coffee?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It is. That's the cinnamon you're smelling. It complements the richness of the butter. Let the aroma permeate your body…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mmm, this is downright delicious! It's got me all warmed up and feeling chirky!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank you kindly, Cafe! I'll remember this taste for as long as I live!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You're definitely exaggerating, but…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If you ever want another, feel free to ask.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It makes me happy too, seeing you take an interest in coffee…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense a warmth in Manhattan Cafe's gentle smile that rivals that of the hot butter au lait.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well hey, that sounds like something I could sip on! Cafe, think you could do that for me?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Of course. If you'd prefer something light and refreshing, I have an idea…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Here you are. A citrus iced coffee tonic.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wait, this is s'posed to be coffee?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Look at all these bubbles, and there's even a lil' orange float'n inside… This looks like some fancy juice!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: At a glance, it does look like a soda… but it is coffee, just with my twist on it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I mixed in some tonic water and added some orange flavor… So the taste will be as crisp and refreshing as the summer sky.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mmm, boy, this is scrumptious! And it's smooth'r than smooth!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y'know, it's sweet, but it's bitt'r at the same time… Gee whiz, what a mature flavor!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm sure grateful for this bev'rage, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I got a real taste of what it's like to be a hip 'n hopp'n city girl!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. I'm glad you feel that way. Feel free to ask if you ever want some more.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: After all, it makes me happy too, seeing you take an interest in coffee…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense a kindness in Manhattan Cafe's gentle smile as refreshing as the taste of citrus.
